lead: A `Core` enum case has no `->name` property, so `$verb->name` is `E0405` and the value around it is `mixed`.
body: A `Core\Http\Method` or any other registry enum crosses as its ordinal and carries no text of its own. Print one through a `match` expression with an arm per case (or a `default` arm), as `docs/examples/types/Http-Method/03-answering-a-wrong-verb-with-the-right-list.nvs` does.
